_note: Copy to config.json (outside git) and edit. Any key here can be overridden by an OFFERINGS_<FIELD> environment variable, and environment variables always win. Leave the four secret fields empty and set OFFERINGS_GMAIL_CLIENT_ID, OFFERINGS_GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET, OFFERINGS_GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN, OFFERINGS_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY and OFFERINGS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment instead. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.

policy._note: Safe testing defaults. allowed_recipient_domains is set to example.com so nothing can reach a real buyer until you clear it (use [] for any domain). Flip live with OFFERINGS_POLICY_LIVE=true or the --live flag once the dry run looks right.
